company.name: Hassle Free Home Services
company.location: Serving MD, DC, VA, CT, GA, FL, IL & MA
company.footerBlurb: Founded in 2003, Hassle Free Home Services is the premier residential preventative maintenance and home concierge management company in the United States. Your home, handled.

hero.title: Your Home, Handled.
hero.subtitle: Proactive seasonal maintenance, routine handyman repairs, and full-service project management. One dedicated, background-checked W-2 technician. Zero contractor headaches.

gallery.title: Modern Exterior Refresh
gallery.description: Lighting upgrades and trim restoration around a premium family home.

gallery.title: Indoor Comfort Upgrade
gallery.description: Seasonal system checks and filter replacement for better airflow and efficiency.

gallery.title: Kitchen & Bath Detail Work
gallery.description: Caulking, fixture updates, and quick repairs completed during a scheduled visit.

gallery.title: Estate Maintenance
gallery.description: Ongoing management for a luxury home across recurring seasonal checklists.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Preventative care and project support designed for busy households.
services.intro: We help homeowners stay ahead of maintenance issues through recurring visits, expert repairs, and hands-on project management.

sections.title: Preventative Maintenance
sections.body: Recurring home inspections keep systems tuned, surfaces protected, and small concerns from turning into costly faults.

sections.title: Repairs & Handyman Tasks
sections.body: From installing fixtures to re-caulking bathrooms and fixing sticking doors, our team handles the tasks that pile up between weekends.

sections.title: Project Coordination
sections.body: We coordinate vetted subcontractors, supervise work, and keep quality standards high from start to finish.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: A local company built around trust, care, and doing things properly.
story.intro: Hassle Free began with a simple idea: homeowners deserve a reliable partner to proactively maintain and improve their homes without the stress of managing contractors.

sections.title: Founded in 2003
sections.body: What started as a focused home services company has grown into a trusted team serving families across multiple regions.

sections.title: Built on Long-Term Relationships
sections.body: We prioritize consistency, communication, and a technician-first experience that homeowners can rely on year after year.

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.body: To make homeownership feel easier by creating a proactive maintenance system that protects value and peace of mind.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Regional service hubs with dedicated local field teams.
locations.intro: We serve homeowners across major metropolitan areas with local dispatch teams that understand the specific needs of each region.

sections.title: Maryland
sections.body: Serving Bethesda, Potomac, Rockville, Silver Spring and surrounding communities.

sections.title: Virginia
sections.body: Coverage across McLean, Great Falls, Vienna, Arlington, Alexandria and more.

sections.title: Connecticut & Georgia
sections.body: Local support for Fairfield County, Metro Atlanta and nearby areas.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.subtitle: Helpful answers for members and new homeowners.
faq.intro: From technician expectations to membership details, these answers help you understand how our service works and what to expect.

sections.title: Who performs the work?
sections.body: All routine maintenance and handyman tasks are completed by our full-time, W-2 employed, background-checked technicians.

sections.title: Is there a contract?
sections.body: Memberships are simple month-to-month plans designed to provide flexibility without long-term lock-in.

sections.title: What if there is an emergency?
sections.body: Members have access to 24/7 emergency support to help prevent damage and keep homes protected.

careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: Join the team that helps homeowners feel supported every day.
careers.intro: We seek dependable, service-minded professionals who care about doing quality work and delivering a great customer experience.

sections.title: Why Join Us?
sections.body: We invest in dependable team members, clear expectations, and a culture built on professionalism.

sections.title: What We Look For
sections.body: Strong communication, craftsmanship, reliability, and a willingness to solve problems proactively.

sections.title: How to Apply
sections.body: Reach out through our contact and scheduling process to start a conversation about joining the team.
